audit: Frozen Track A A1/A2/A3 output-level family ablation sensitivity; diagnostic-only

method.source: Verify the frozen final-two registrations, preregistered cohort card, candidate CSVs and candidate source manifests. Recompute R/B/F/Est selected-idea component estimates and masks from their hash-verified idea artifacts using each candidate's already registered family weights; A3 F uses only its frozen Dawid-Skene witnesses/parameters.
method.family_ablation: Drop exactly one of R/B/F/Est. R/B are marked undefined with zero storage placeholder; for F/Est ablations, poi_gap is the remaining defined half (undefined if neither is available). Component weights/mappings are otherwise unchanged.
method.composite: Counterfactual uses the registered Track-A equal mean of the remaining defined R, B, and POI output components, renormalized per GEOID. Reported composite change is the difference between this all-family and ablated reweighted composition, added as a delta to the frozen candidate composite solely to express an output-level sensitivity. This is diagnostic and does not change a candidate.
method.A1_limitation: A1's frozen composite is the registered Sca5 expected-definedness composite with region-level Dst5 anchoring, not the equal-defined component mean used by A2/A3. This audit does not refit/recompute Sca5; it reports the A1 frozen-composite versus all-family reweighted-output difference separately and applies only the component-recomposition delta. Thus A1 ablation is an output-level sensitivity, not a replay of Sca5 internals.
method.metric: Per region, p50/p95/max of absolute changes in each output gap component and composite. Component metrics use original component-defined GEOIDs; composite metrics use all official candidate rows. Exact masks are in the companion CSV and mask hashes are included in metric entries.
method.interpretation: Finite descriptive sensitivity only; it is not estimator accuracy, candidate selection, new weights, or an authorization to change/submit candidates.

exact_geoID_masks.mask_values: 0/1 defined indicators per official GEOID, candidate, baseline component, ablation, and post-ablation component/composite.
